description:
Record and report time worked on threads, billable or not.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — add a time entry
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change one field of an entry
  rm ID -y — delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD  a name, 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink
  DESCRIPTION  a short invoice line label; one element or several words
  ID  the entry's 8-char id from list

Flags:
  log: -m/--minutes is the duration (default 60; must be positive). -r/--rate is the hourly rate; 0 means unbillable. -c/--currency is an ISO code; defaults to the thread's currency. With no currency from either, the entry is recorded as unbilled. -d/--date is YYYY-MM-DD (default today). -t/--time is the HH:MM start (default now).
  list, report: --since and --until take YYYY-MM-DD. --json gives JSON output.
  edit: --description sets a new description. -m changes the duration and keeps the start. -r sets a new rate and needs a currency. -c sets a new currency. -d moves the entry to another day and -t to another start time; both keep the duration.
  rm: -y (or --yes) is required.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation", "-m", "180", "-d", "2026-09-28"]
  ["report", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "abcd1234", "-m", "90"]
  ["rm", "abcd1234", "-y"]

Notes:
  edit --description takes several words, so put it last, after ID and the other flags.
  Keep descriptions to short labels: search does not index hours. Put detail in a log with buffer add-text.
  log also queues a REF in the buffer under the work date. It reaches the daily log on the next buffer flush.
  log, edit and rm rewrite the thread's hours file. rm is permanent.
  Exit 1: minutes not positive, rate given without a currency, empty description.
